design_profile.composition: clear silhouette hierarchy designed at thumbnail scale
design_profile.proportion: exaggerate identity-bearing forms to survive low resolution
design_profile.space_model: discrete depth bands with overlap and palette separation
design_profile.shape_grammar: clean pixel clusters with intentional stair-stepping and no isolated noise
design_profile.value_structure: four to six grouped values checked in monochrome
design_profile.color_system: one shared indexed-style palette with controlled ramps
design_profile.edge_system: binary hard edges and cluster-aware curves
design_profile.lighting: designed value ramps rather than downsampled photographic light
design_profile.rhythm: repeat cluster sizes and dither patterns consistently across layers

prompt_constraints: Draw on the logical pixel grid
Never use anti-aliasing or partial alpha
